Hi Priya,

Hope you had a good week — we’re coming up on BrightWave’s annual renewal window and the execs have asked for a combined QBR + roadmap/demo so they can evaluate the expansion path. High level: we need a 60–75 minute session (exec overview + technical breakout) with stakeholders from Product, IT (network/security), and Procurement.

Attendees: Lisa Carter (VP Product, exec sponsor) — currently tentatively available mornings PT; Liam O'Connor (IT lead) — afternoons PT; Purchasing team available 10:00–16:00 PT most days.

Proposed weeks: July 12–16 or July 19–23. Our preference is a single time that keeps execs in the first half of the session. Can you share 2–3 concrete slots (with timezone) and an agenda? Also: could you attach a short SOC2 summary and a mutual action plan template so my procurement lead can start the review?

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Park
Customer Success Manager
BrightWave Health

Note: We will need an operations contact from your side for VPC peering/network questions. If you have a brief pre-demo checklist that’d be helpful too.
